items.title: Pierpoint Plaque Installation Approval
notes: Report from L. Rogerson, Manager of Parks

L. Rogerson, Manager of Parks provided an overview, indicating Parks Canada Agency is seeking permission to install a Richard Pierpoint Commemorative Plaque at the Pierpoint Fly Fishing Nature Reserve.
Staff responded to questions regarding the proposed location of the plaque, and the need for improved wayfinding signage.

items.title: Victoria Park Stairs Update
notes: Report from P. Newson, Managing Director of Community Services P. Newson, Managing Director of Community Services provided an overview of the report, explaining the design for the new stairs was completed and the tender issued in July 2023 with results received in August. The project cost is higher than the anticipated estimated at $625,000 which exceeds the current budget. She indicated staff is recommending placing a hold on the project to pursue alternative sources of funding and report back to Council.
Staff responded to questions regarding safety, current and new funding sources, utilizing the community partnership program, and maintaining portages.
Members of Council requested a report from staff on the communication plan for the community partnership program.
After questions and a brief discussion, Councillor Lustgarten-Evoy suggested an amendment to the recommendation to secure the information prior to the 2025 budget.
